name: Udzec
description: The maximum security Azorius prison, said to hold fifty thousand prisoners.

timeline.summary: At Udzec, Olrich dresses as a baby and swallows the bloodfray amulet, and Kodolaag frames the minotaur Jitka Wothis by hiding a whiskey bottle in her cape to distract the nullmages.
timeline.quote: Carefully, carefully I rest the bottle inside, hoping it's light enough not to pull the fabric.

timeline.summary: Kodolaag finds Zita under an Azorius spell that makes prisoners praise their imprisonment and realizes everything is not fine.
timeline.quote: The guards must be forcing the prisoners to speak fondly about their internment—or else.

pages_say.description: The maximum security Azorius prison, said to hold fifty thousand prisoners.
The prison from which Dryzek has just been released.
